scope_note: Evidence-supported guidance is separated from conservative inference and explicit product requirements.

principles.principle: Keep resume content as selectable text with conventional sections and explicit fields.
principles.conservative_default: Summary, Skills, Experience, Projects, Education, Certifications; only include applicable sections.
principles.observable_check: Structured text fields are present; no fact depends on an image or decorative glyph.

principles.principle: Use predictable linear content order; avoid encoding column or text-box relationships into generated text.
principles.observable_check: Artifact has ordered sections and entries.
exceptions_or_limits: Correctly tagged columns can be accessible; parser behavior remains vendor-specific.

principles.principle: Keep organization, title and date fields consistent and independently identifiable.
exceptions_or_limits: Do not append corporate suffixes or expand ambiguous job titles unless evidence supports them.

principles.principle: Align relevant terminology only when candidate evidence entails the term.
principles.observable_check: Supported terms only; adjacent technology is not an alias.

principles.principle: Treat parser compatibility and recruiter relevance as separate dimensions; never promise a universal ATS score.
principles.observable_check: No universal pass guarantee or opaque ATS percentage.

principles.principle: Use platform-specific file constraints only when the target system is known.
principles.observable_check: Renderer applies explicit destination requirements, not one global limit.
exceptions_or_limits: Greenhouse documents 2.5 MB parsing limit; USAJOBS documents 5 MB upload limit. They describe different systems and operations.

principles.principle: No hidden keywords or unsupported skill insertion is an acceptable optimization.
principles.observable_check: Every candidate-specific keyword has grounding; all visible content matches emitted content.
